messages:
Anya: Heads-up — planning to onboard horizon-lite v1.0 into catalog slot 42 tomorrow at 15:00 PT. Owner: @Mike. Can folks confirm smoke window + rollback owner?
Mike: I can own the deploy and smoke. Will be around for the 15:00 PT window.
Sanjay: I'll do preflight perf checks and validate tail-latency on staging. Planning to run the usual perf sweep (10k tokens mixed).
Lina: I'll review the model pin PR this morning and post any blockers by 12:00 PT. @Mike please ping when the PR is ready for final.
Anya: PRs: model-catalog#879 (add horizon-lite v1.0), infra#2102 (slot42 capacity). Mike, can you confirm infra is green for the pinned slot?
Mike: infra looks fine. slot42 has 3 reserved instances, can burst 1.5x for 10m. I've set autoscale cooldown to 60s for the window.
Sanjay: Quick checklist for me: smoke samples (100 short, 100 long), kv-cache warmup, prefix coverage. Also will run latency histogram before/after.
Lina: Code review notes: need a small docstring change and metadata key "quant_profile: lite4" added. Nothing blocking.
Mike: Deploy plan (brief): 1) merge PRs, 2) pin alias -> new version (canary 5%), 3) run smoke suite, 4) increase to 25% for 10m, 5) full swap if clean. Rollback: alias -> previous version and revert pin.
Anya: Who will watch metrics during the 25% window? Need two eyes on error-rate and p95.
Mike: I'll watch latency + errors. @Sanjay can you watch cost/instances and KV hit-rate?
Sanjay: Yep. I'll post metric snapshots to thread. I'll watch p95, p99, and KV hit (target > 85%).
Lina: Also add QA test for structured outputs — quick spot-check 10 prompts. If any hallucinations > threshold, abort.
Anya: Deploy bot: schedule request?
deploy-bot: @Mike — scheduled deploy for horizon-lite v1.0 into slot42 at 2026-03-18T15:00:00-07:00. Canary 5% for 5m, escalate to 25% if smoke passes.
Mike: Running smoke script locally before merge: ```./scripts/smoke_run.sh --model horizon-lite --samples 200 --kv-warmup true```
Sanjay: Perf command I'll run after canary: ```python tools/bench.py --model horizon-lite --seq 512 --clients 50 --duration 300```
Lina: If anyone needs to rollback quickly, use: ```redwoodctl alias set catalog:horizon-lite=catalog:horizon-lite@<previous-version> --reason "rollback"``` — tested this earlier.
Anya: OK — Lina approves PR, Mike owns deploy and rollback, Sanjay owns perf/watch. I'll be on-call for coordination. Please post any preflight failures here by 13:00 PT so we can reschedule. :thumbsup:
Mike: Will do. I'll ping again when PR merged and when canary starts.
Sanjay: Preflight started — kicking off perf sweep now, will post results in ~20m.
Lina: LGTM, merging after CI passes.
Mike: CI passed, merging now. Starting canary at scheduled time.
Sanjay: Preflight perf: p95 staging=88ms, p99=210ms, KV hit=92%. Looks good to me.
Anya: Great — thanks team, keep updates short in this thread during the window.
